youtube.title: Loss Ke Baad Bada Trade? Revenge Trading Account Kha Jaata Hai #Shorts
youtube.description:
Revenge trading: loss ke baad bada, jaldi aur bina plan ka trade. Recovery ka maths: 10% loss ke baad ~11% chahiye, 50% loss ke baad 100%. Ek simple rule: market khulne se pehle din ka maximum loss fix karo.
लॉस के बाद बड़ा ट्रेड, गड्ढा और गहरा करता है।

Is video ke numbers:
• Recovery maths: zaroori gain = loss ÷ (1 − loss). 10% loss → 11.1%; 50% loss → 100%

Kabhi same din loss wapas jeetne ki koshish ki hai? Kya hua? 👇

caption:
₹5,000 ka loss → ₹20,000 ka trade? 🛑 RUKO!

Revenge trading accounts kha jaata hai:
−10% → wapas aane ke liye +11%
−50% → +100% chahiye 😬

Rule: market khulne se pehle din ka MAX LOSS fix karo. Hit hua → app band, uth jaao.

Market kal bhi rahega. Paisa bhi rehna chahiye.
